title: Review expense claims the finance team's way
when: reviewing the month's employee expense claims in claims.csv, with the exchange rates in rates.csv, before they are paid
request: Review the expense claims in claims.csv (exchange rates in rates.csv). Write REVIEW.md for the finance lead and review.json with: claims (one per claim: {"claim_id", "decision": "approve" | "reject" | "ask", "reimburse_usd", "fx_rate" (null for USD claims), "reason"}), totals (reimbursed USD per employee), total_usd and open_decisions (list of strings).
